description: This Python source file defines a factory for generating FastAPI container proxy endpoints dynamically from a JSON configuration. It includes functions to load endpoint configurations, create route handlers based on path parameters, process binary and general requests, and register all endpoints with a FastAPI router, supporting dynamic and flexible API endpoint creation for container file operations.

methods.name: _load_endpoints_config
methods.description: Loads the endpoints configuration from a JSON file located relative to the current file.

methods.name: get_all_route_types
methods.description: Retrieves all async route types defined in the endpoints configuration.

methods.name: _get_container_provider_config
methods.description: Returns container provider configuration object based on the provider name, supporting 'openai'.

methods.name: _create_handler_for_path_params
methods.description: Dynamically creates FastAPI route handler functions based on specified path parameters and route type, including special handling for binary content endpoints.

methods.name: _process_binary_request
methods.description: Handles binary file content requests, determines content type based on file extension, and returns the file content as a Response.

methods.name: _process_request
methods.description: Shared logic for processing general LLM requests, including extracting query parameters, setting up processing, and handling exceptions.

methods.name: register_container_file_endpoints
methods.description: Registers all container file endpoints defined in the JSON configuration to a given FastAPI APIRouter, supporting both binary and JSON responses.
